services.value: PFAS laboratories offers PFAS testing services including diagnostic water testing with turnaround times, EPA Method 537.1v2, EPA 1633 (40 compounds), and 537MOD (liquids and solids), as well as Well Water PLUS Soil Test Kits. It also provides PFAS testing for commercial needs such as advanced air emissions monitoring and analysis using EPA Methods 8421 and 8327.
